mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) combined with gemfibrozil may increase serotonergic activity and gemfibrozil can potentiate fibrate effects on lipid metabolism while MAOIs affect sympathomimetic responses, creating additive cardiovascular and metabolic stress.
action: Avoid concomitant use if possible; if necessary, use with extreme caution with close cardiovascular monitoring and consider alternative antilipemic agents with safer MAOI profiles.
